scope: Uncommitted seven-file medium Dynamic Island screenshot change only. Onboarding, matrix, accessibility callbacks, native rendering and release acceptance excluded.

findings.title: Route screenshot delivery through the native dimension validator
findings.body: H1 still directs the owner to fetch nightly ci-results/app screenshots and invoke screenshots.py directly. Nightly chooses the first arbitrary iPhone simulator (nightly.yml:36); screenshots.render does not invoke listing_assets.capture_records. After this change its frame_size composes a large 1320x2868 raw source into 1206x2622 and size_problem accepts that pair. Therefore following the documented upload path bypasses the new native medium requirement despite the claim old large captures cannot substitute. Point H1 at the listing-assets workflow and mechanically verified medium screenshot manifest inventory, or explicitly validate native source dimensions before this standalone route.

observations: Required device sizes specify at least one medium Dynamic Island iPhone screenshot and one 13-inch iPad screenshot for iPadOS apps.
Medium dimensions include 1206x2622; device list includes iPhone 17 Pro and 16 Pro.

source_verification: Tests reviewed before implementation. Three regressions cover rejecting large raw captures, required default frame dimensions, and rejection of a large rendered manifest. Device fixture distinguishes medium vs Pro Max.
Native runner selects 17 Pro/16 Pro for iphone, keeps 17 Pro Max/16 Pro Max for both preview kinds, and keeps iPad Pro 13-inch path unchanged.
Raw capture_records, rendered screenshot_records and aggregate rendered-size validation consistently use 1206x2622 for iphone. Preview dimensions and Watch source files unchanged.
English heading parser accepts renamed main/CPP headings; fresh probe finds 9 main frames and violin/cello/ukulele CPP pages.
Compositor sizes and margins scale using short-side unit. Actual caption-layout audit at new size remains necessary; older large-size audit does not prove new-size fit.

independent_checks.check: Synthetic large native source versus medium output frame_size/size_problem

limits: Windows-only independent verification; no native Xcode/simulator/device run performed.
